_catatan: Sunting berkas ini untuk mengubah topik, jurnal prioritas, dan perilaku. Query memakai sintaks pencarian OpenAlex: AND, OR, NOT, tanda kutip untuk frasa. Hindari tanda koma di dalam query.

topics.name: Akses & informasi pasar petani
topics.query: (smallholder OR farmer OR farmers) AND ("market access" OR "market information" OR "price information" OR "market participation" OR "farm gate price" OR "farm-gate price")

topics.name: Pemasaran, rantai pasok & rantai nilai
topics.query: (agricultural OR agriculture OR farmer OR smallholder) AND ("value chain" OR "supply chain" OR "marketing channel" OR "marketing margin" OR middlemen OR traders OR "contract farming")

topics.name: Kelembagaan petani & tindakan kolektif
topics.query: ("farmer group" OR "farmer groups" OR "farmer organization" OR "farmer organisations" OR "producer organization" OR cooperative OR cooperatives OR "collective action") AND (smallholder OR farmers OR agriculture OR agricultural)

topics.name: Pemberdayaan petani & gender
topics.query: (women OR gender OR empowerment OR "female farmers") AND (farmer OR farmers OR smallholder OR agriculture OR agricultural OR rural)

topics.name: Ketahanan pangan rumah tangga
topics.query: ("food security" OR "food insecurity" OR "dietary diversity") AND (household OR households OR smallholder OR rural OR farmers)

topics.name: Kelapa sawit
topics.query: ("oil palm" OR "palm oil") AND (smallholder OR smallholders OR productivity OR yield OR harvest OR labour OR labor OR price OR prices OR certification OR livelihood OR independent)

topics.name: Adopsi teknologi & pertanian digital
topics.query: (smallholder OR smallholders OR farmer OR farmers) AND ("technology adoption" OR "digital agriculture" OR "mobile phone" OR "digital platform" OR "e-commerce" OR "digital technology" OR "information and communication technology" OR "agricultural extension")

topics.name: Pembangunan pedesaan & kebijakan pertanian
topics.query: ("rural development" OR "agricultural policy" OR "rural livelihoods" OR "agrarian change") AND (Indonesia OR "Southeast Asia" OR smallholder OR smallholders OR "developing countries")

topics.name: Komoditas: pisang, nanas, padi rawa
topics.query: (banana OR bananas OR pineapple OR "swamp rice" OR "tidal rice" OR "tidal swamp" OR "peatland agriculture") AND (farmer OR farmers OR marketing OR "supply chain" OR economic OR livelihood OR income)

topics.name: Tenaga kerja & produktivitas perkebunan
topics.query: (plantation OR plantations OR "oil palm" OR estate) AND ("labour productivity" OR "labor productivity" OR workers OR "harvesting" OR "yield gap" OR wages)
